text: The earlier port listed asan, opt, os != 'mac' and tsan separately. This correction uses os != 'mac' && asan, os != 'mac' && opt and os != 'mac' && tsan, and those three strings remain at the fixed accepted revision. Keep this follow-up distinct from the original condition port. The exact upstream list evaluator and build-flag producers are outside this comm-only proof, so the source change is not a general rule for all run-if arrays.
title: The delete-item manifest correction repeats the platform guard inside each build condition
